name: Rehabit
tagline: Turns a webcam into a home rehab coach that measures symmetry, range of motion and rep quality.

awards: Most Likely to Become a Startup

problem: Rehab after stroke or injury is hard to access and to measure at home.
solution: Guided drills tracked by joint angles produce a symmetry score, range of motion and rep quality; Gemini writes a plain-English progress report.
demo_moment: Team-described: do sit-to-stand reps and read the symmetry score.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Likely to Become a Startup” among 217 submissions.
Objective numbers instead of 'how did it feel'.

lessons: Measurement is the product when the alternative is self-report.
